# Security Policy

We take all security vulnerabilities seriously.
If you have a vulnerability or other security issues to disclose:

- Thank you very much, please do!
- Please report them privately by [opening a security advisory on GitHub](https://github.com/KyleTryon/eslint-plugin-structured-logging/security/advisories/new), or by emailing the maintainer at `SECURITY_CONTACT_EMAIL`.

Please do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

We appreciate your efforts and responsible disclosure and will make every effort to acknowledge your contributions.
